fields.statement: At 14d9f17, as QA with a scratch build (go build -o $TMPDIR) in a scratch repo with a local bare origin and a fake gh that reports origin's branch head: after the run's own ship rebase pushed eb82547 (recorded as pushed), a second clone pushed 0b34323 on top; ship check --settled exited 0 at once, a green ship check wrote head=pushed=0b34323, and ship merge --json returned head 0b34323. A force-pushed rewrite 592a57a that dropped those commits gave 'not settled: the pull request's head 592a57a drops the pushed 0b34323', and --settled exited 1. go test ./internal/api -run TestShip and the ship-check-follows-moved-head testscript pass.

At 14d9f17, as QA with a scratch build in a scratch repo with a bare origin: a second clone pushed a commit to cs/ship-it. With feature.txt modified, ship rebase exited 3 with 'origin's cs/ship-it has moved to 30b4e3a, but <repo> has uncommitted changes that stop it following: M feature.txt' and HEAD stayed put. Once the worktree was clean, ship rebase exited 0 and HEAD equalled the moved head. With a local commit origin lacked ('Raise a question on the rebase conflicts') and origin ahead, ship rebase exited 3 naming '429a4e6 Raise a question on the rebase conflicts', and HEAD stayed put. The ship-follows-pr-head testscript passes.

At 14d9f17, as QA with a scratch build in a scratch repo: when main conflicted on shared.txt, ship rebase raised rebase-conflict-ship-it and exited 1. A second clone then merged main into cs/ship-it with a resolution (14a1dab) and pushed it, and main moved again with unrelated commits. ship rebase exited 0: it merged origin/main into the branch ('Merge origin/main into cs/ship-it' plus a render commit) instead of rebasing, raised no new question, and pushed eb82547. 14a1dab is an ancestor of the pushed head, and origin equals local. The run-ship-change-rebase testscript (cases 3 and 4) passes.
